achievements.name: Just a Scratch
achievements.description: Complete 'Enter, Pursued by a Memory'.

steps: Play the opening snow missions until you finish "Enter, Pursued by a Memory".

achievements.name: Back in the Mud
achievements.description: Complete Chapter 1.

steps: Finish every Chapter 1 story mission through the snow escape.
Chapter select is unavailable early — play in order.

achievements.name: Trusty Steed
achievements.description: Reach max bonding level with a horse.

steps: Reach maximum bonding level with your horse (pat, feed, ride frequently).
Keep the same horse until the bonding bar maxes.

achievements.name: Give to the Poor
achievements.description: Donate $250 to the gang tithing box.

steps: Open the camp ledger / tithing box when you are at camp.
Donate until you have given a total of $250.

achievements.name: To Greener Pastures
achievements.description: Complete Chapter 2.

steps: Complete all Chapter 2 story missions out of Horseshoe Overlook.
Optional strangers can wait — story missions gate the chapter clear.

achievements.name: Locked and Loaded
achievements.description: Upgrade each available component for a single sidearm or longarm weapon.

steps: At a gunsmith, fully upgrade every available component on one sidearm or longarm.

achievements.name: Take From the Rich
achievements.description: Rob or loot $250.

steps: Rob trains, coaches, homesteads, or loot bodies/cash registers.
Accumulate $250 total from robbery/looting (not normal mission payouts alone).

achievements.name: Settling Feuds
achievements.description: Complete Chapter 3.

steps: Complete all Chapter 3 story missions around Clemens Point.
Finish the last Chapter 3 mission to unlock the achievement.

achievements.name: Breakout
achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Complete the Intro.

steps: Launch Red Dead Online from the title screen.
Finish the Online introduction / tutorial flow.

achievements.name: Washed Ashore
achievements.description: Complete Chapter 4.

steps: Play through Chapter 4 story missions from Saint Denis / related camp.
Complete the final Chapter 4 mission.

achievements.name: No Traitors
achievements.description: Complete Chapter 5.

steps: Complete every Chapter 5 story mission (Guarma and aftermath).
Finish the last Chapter 5 mission.

achievements.name: Third Time Lucky
achievements.description: Complete 'Goodbye, Dear Friend'.

steps: Complete the story mission 'Goodbye, Dear Friend' in Chapter 6.

achievements.name: Redemption
achievements.description: Complete 'Red Dead Redemption'.

steps: Progress Chapter 6 until the mission 'Red Dead Redemption'.
Complete that mission.

achievements.name: Cowboy Builder
achievements.description: Complete 'A New Jerusalem'.

steps: In the Epilogue, complete the mission 'A New Jerusalem'.

achievements.name: Endless Summer
achievements.description: Complete the Epilogue.

steps: Play as John in the Epilogue.
Complete every Epilogue Part 1 and Part 2 story mission through the final ranch / ending beat.

achievements.name: Extreme Personality
achievements.description: Reach maximum or minimum Honor level.

steps: Raise Honor to the maximum (help strangers, donate, peaceful choices) or dump it to minimum (loot, kill innocents, antagonize).
Check the Honor bar in the pause menu — tip must reach either extreme.

achievements.name: It was THIS Big!
achievements.description: Catch a fish weighing at least 16 lbs (7.3 kg).

steps: Buy a fishing rod and use the right bait for large species (Lake Sturgeon, Channel Catfish, etc.).
Catch any fish weighing at least 16 lb / 7.3 kg — lakes near Flat Iron Lake are good.

achievements.name: Breaking and Entering
achievements.description: Recover the stash from 4 homesteads.

steps: Find homestead robbery locations (often marked after encounters or on MapGenie).
Recover the stash from 4 different homesteads.

achievements.name: Friends With Benefits
achievements.description: Complete a Companion Activity in each camp.

steps: At camp, look for companion activity prompts (with Dutch, Hosea, Charles, etc.).
Complete at least one companion activity in each camp you live at across chapters.

achievements.name: Getting Started
achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Reach Rank 10.

steps: Progress the story until you unlock: Red Dead Online: Reach Rank 10.
Play on any difficulty — story achievements are mostly unmissable if you finish the game.

achievements.name: Pony Up
achievements.description: Spend $5000 across all shops.

steps: Spend money at general stores, gunsmiths, stables, doctors, hotels, etc.
Reach $5000 total spent across all shops (cumulative).

achievements.name: Self Sufficient
achievements.description: Craft 30 unique items in Story Mode.

steps: At a campfire or crafting menu, craft different recipes (tonics, food, ammo types, etc.).
Craft 30 unique item types in Story Mode.

achievements.name: Strength in Numbers
achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Complete a Free Roam mission as part of a Posse with at least 2 members.

steps: Progress the story until you unlock: Red Dead Online: Complete a Free Roam mission as part of a Posse with at least 2 members.
Play on any difficulty — story achievements are mostly unmissable if you finish the game.

achievements.name: Western Stranger
achievements.description: Complete 10 Stranger mission strands.

steps: Progress the story until you unlock: Complete 10 Stranger mission strands.
Play on any difficulty — story achievements are mostly unmissable if you finish the game.

achievements.name: Hobby Horse
achievements.description: Play all mini games.

steps: Play each mini-game at least once: Poker, Blackjack, Dominoes, Five Finger Fillet, and any others listed in the Compendium.
Towns and camps host tables — check MapGenie for locations.

achievements.name: Buckle Up
achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Achieve 5 gold belt buckles from awards.

steps: In Red Dead Online, open Awards and work toward gold belt buckles.
Earn gold on 5 different award categories.

achievements.name: Butchered
achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Sell 20 items to the Butcher.

steps: In Red Dead Online, hunt or gather animal parts.
Sell 20 items to any Butcher.

achievements.name: Lending a Hand
achievements.description: Complete all optional Honor story missions.

steps: Complete every optional Honor story mission (high-honor side story opportunities).
These appear as optional mission markers during later chapters — do them before they expire.
warnings: Can be missed if you rush past chapter windows — check for optional yellow markers.

achievements.name: Errand Boy
achievements.description: Deliver 5 camp companion item requests.

steps: At camp, talk to companions until they request a specific item.
Find and deliver 5 of these item requests (Pearson, Hosea, etc.).
warnings: Some requests are chapter-limited — do them while that companion is in camp.

achievements.name: Gun For Hire
achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Accept 10 Free Roam missions from characters around the world.

steps: Progress the story until you unlock: Red Dead Online: Accept 10 Free Roam missions from characters around the world.
Play on any difficulty — story achievements are mostly unmissable if you finish the game.

achievements.name: Picked to Perfection
achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Pick 25 Herbs.

steps: In Red Dead Online, pick herbs in free roam.
Collect 25 herbs (any combination).

achievements.name: Master Craftsman
achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Craft 20 items (excluding ammo).

steps: In Red Dead Online, use a camp fire / crafting menu.
Craft 20 items that are not ammunition.

achievements.name: Series Major
achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Take part in a Series.

steps: From the Online menu, join any Series playlist (Showdown, Race, etc.).
Participate in at least one Series match.

achievements.name: Collector's Item
achievements.description: Complete one of the Collectable strands.

steps: Start any collectible strand (Cigarette Cards, Dinosaur Bones, Dreamcatchers, etc.).
Fully complete one collectible set / strand.

achievements.name: Artificial Intelligence
achievements.description: Discover the fate of Marko Dragic.

steps: Progress the story until you unlock: Discover the fate of Marko Dragic.
Play on any difficulty — story achievements are mostly unmissable if you finish the game.

achievements.name: Posse Up
achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Form a Persistent Posse.

steps: In Red Dead Online, open the Posse menu.
Create a Persistent Posse (not just a temporary one).

achievements.name: Notorious
achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Reach Rank 50.

steps: Play Red Dead Online activities, missions, and free roam to earn XP.
Reach Online Rank 50.

achievements.name: Home Comforts
achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Purchase 5 camp improvements.

steps: Open your Online camp theme / improvements catalog.
Purchase 5 camp improvements.

achievements.name: Skin Deep
achievements.description: Skin every species of animal in Story Mode.

steps: Hunt and skin animals across all regions; study the Compendium list.
Skin every animal species required in Story Mode.

achievements.name: Zoologist
achievements.description: Study every animal across all states in Story Mode.

steps: Study every animal species across all states with binoculars/scope.
Use MapGenie animal checklists — legendary animals are separate from study counts.

achievements.name: Paying Respects
achievements.description: Find the graves of each of your fallen companions.

steps: After the story/epilogue, visit the grave of each fallen companion.
Arthur’s grave and other gang graves are marked — stand/interact at each.

achievements.name: Best in the West
achievements.description: Attain 100% completion.

steps: Attain 100% completion (story, strangers, hobbies, collectibles, miscellaneous checklist).
Track remaining % in the pause menu and clear MapGenie markers.

achievements.name: All's Fair
achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Successfully counter a rival Posse's Free Roam mission.

steps: Progress the story until you unlock: Red Dead Online: Successfully counter a rival Posse's Free Roam mission.
Play on any difficulty — story achievements are mostly unmissable if you finish the game.

achievements.name: Eventful
achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Play 5 Free Roam Events.

steps: Join Free Roam Events when they pop up on the Online map / toast notifications.
Complete 5 Free Roam Events.

achievements.name: Gold Rush
achievements.description: Earn 70 Gold Medals in Story missions.

steps: Earn Gold Medals on 70 Story missions (replay from the log to improve ranks).

achievements.name: Horses for Courses
achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Concurrently own 5 horses.

steps: Buy or acquire horses at stables in Red Dead Online.
Own 5 horses at the same time in your stable.

achievements.name: Bountiful
achievements.description: Survive 3 days holding a bounty of $250 in all states.

steps: Hold a bounty of at least $250 in every state for 3 full days without clearing it.
Avoid lawmen / sleep-wait carefully while the timer runs.

achievements.name: Non-Regulation
achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Craft 25 pieces of ammunition.

steps: In Red Dead Online, craft ammunition at a campfire (split point, express, etc.).
Craft 25 pieces of ammunition total.

achievements.name: Grin and Bear it
achievements.description: Survive 18 bear attacks and kill the bear each time in Story Mode.

steps: Get attacked by a bear 18 separate times and kill that bear each time.
Save before engagements so you can repeat safely.

achievements.name: It's Art
achievements.description: Find a permanent home for the squirrel statue.

steps: Obtain the squirrel statue collectible and find its permanent home placement.
Follow the related stranger/collectible chain (MapGenie marks the statue path).

achievements.name: The Real Deal
achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Achieve MVP 3 times (in a round with at least 4 players).

steps: Play Online PvP / Series modes with at least 4 players in the round.
Finish as MVP three separate times.
